title: MuxCore Configuration
description: Configuration file for the muxcored server.

cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate PEM. Required in production.

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key PEM. Required in production.

cert_file.description: Path to gRPC TLS certificate PEM.

key_file.description: Path to gRPC TLS private key PEM.

mtls_enabled.description: Require mutual TLS from connecting clients.

ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate for mTLS client verification.

seed_nodes.description: Cluster seed node addresses (host:port) to auto-join on startup. TLS required.

join_token.description: Pre-shared token required to join the cluster. Empty = no auth.

database.description: Database connection (driver provided by a database module).

url.description: Connection URL. Credentials are redacted in logs.

cache.description: Cache connection (driver provided by a cache module).

url.description: Connection URL. Credentials are redacted in logs.

path.description: File path for JSONL audit log. Empty = disabled (no overhead).

storage.description: Storage orchestrator per-operation timeouts. Prevents hung providers from blocking callers.

read_timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for Get, Exists, Stat, List, Stream operations.

write_timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for Put operations (large files need more time).

delete_timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for Delete and Move operations.

modules.description: Per-module configuration. Keys are module IDs; values are arbitrary objects passed to the module.

additionalProperties.description: Module-specific configuration. Shape is defined by each module.
